correctness.rationale: For a fixed d-space U in the common left/right radical, bilinear B factors through (V/U)⊗(V/U) or Sym²(V/U), of input dimension N(r-d). For fixed t-space image W0 the surjective tensor count H_q(N(r-d),t) follows linear-map rank, and subspace-lattice Möbius inversion over j-dimensional enlargements of U yields [r d]_q[s t]_q sum_j (-1)^j q^{binom(j,2)}[r-d j]_q H_q(N(r-d-j),t). Radical-line count X has EX=[r 1]_q q^{-s c1}, second factorial moment bounded by C([r 1]_q,2)q^{-s c2}, c1=r,c2=2r-1 in symmetric; c1=2r-1,c2=4r-4 general. For fixed q,s (s>=2 symmetric, s>=1 general), Bonferroni leads to advertised sharp constants, and two-space union bound concentrates D=1 given D>0. Failure of full image has probability <=[s 1]_q q^{-N(r)}, negligible compared with rare excess so conditioning T=s preserves laws. Independent q=2,r=s=2 enumeration of all 256 general and 64 symmetric tensor maps matched all (D,T) strata. The general family is two-sided radical, not usual one-sided socle; s=1 symmetric rare law deliberately excluded.
